title: AutoVOT tutorial example manual VOT data
why_promising: Public speech/audio + Praat TextGrid pairs distributed with AutoVOT. The project documentation explicitly states that the tutorial TextGrids contain a VOT tier with manually aligned/hand-measured VOT intervals, and direct repository enumeration confirms paired WAV/TextGrid artifacts in the training tree. The example data were provided by the McGill Speech Learning Lab and Prosody Lab and therefore may contribute primary production VOT landmarks suitable for the manual-production database if lineage and redistribution terms are clear.
open_question: Before core promotion, identify the original study/recording lineage and speakers, determine whether these exact recordings duplicate Big Brother/PGWords or another pre-existing corpus, enumerate train/test pairs and hand-labeled versus prediction/window tiers separately, and resolve whether the repository's LGPL license applies to the example speech/TextGrid data or only the software. Admit only hand-measured VOT annotations; exclude AutoVOT predictions and any force-aligned tiers not exhaustively human-verified.
